# googleplay_subscription (Resource)

A subscription of an app, with its listings, its tax settings and its base plans and their regional prices.

Base plans are part of this resource because that is how the API changes them: a base plan is created and edited by updating the subscription, and has no create or update call of its own. Only its state and its deletion have dedicated calls, and the provider makes them for you.

The resource is authoritative for the subscription's base plans: one that exists in Play Console and not in the configuration is planned for removal.

~> **What Google Play does not let you undo.** A product id is reserved forever. A base plan can be deleted only while it is a draft: removing an active or inactive one from the configuration is an error, so retire it with `state = "INACTIVE"` and keep it declared. A subscription can be deleted only if none of its base plans was ever activated: destroying one that cannot be deleted deactivates its active base plans, removes it from state with a warning, and leaves it in Play Console.

Subscription offers (free trials, introductory prices) are not managed yet. Changing the price of a region changes it for new subscribers; moving existing subscribers to it (`migratePrices`) is not managed either.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "googleplay_subscription" "premium" {
  package_name = "com.example.app"
  product_id   = "premium"

  listings = {
    "en-US" = {
      title       = "Premium"
      description = "Everything in the app, on every device."
      benefits    = ["No ads", "Offline access", "Family sharing"]
    }
    "fr-FR" = {
      title = "Premium"
    }
  }

  base_plans = {
    # A new base plan is a draft until its state says otherwise.
    monthly = {
      state = "ACTIVE"

      auto_renewing = {
        billing_period_duration = "P1M"
        grace_period_duration   = "P7D"
      }

      regional_configs = {
        US = {
          price                       = { currency_code = "USD", amount = "4.99" }
          new_subscriber_availability = true
        }
        GB = {
          price                       = { currency_code = "GBP", amount = "4.49" }
          new_subscriber_availability = true
        }
        JP = {
          price                       = { currency_code = "JPY", amount = "800" }
          new_subscriber_availability = true
        }
      }

      # Prices for any region Google Play launches in later.
      other_regions_config = {
        usd_price                   = { currency_code = "USD", amount = "4.99" }
        eur_price                   = { currency_code = "EUR", amount = "4.59" }
        new_subscriber_availability = true
      }
    }

    yearly = {
      state = "ACTIVE"

      auto_renewing = {
        billing_period_duration = "P1Y"
      }

      offer_tags = ["best-value"]

      regional_configs = {
        US = {
          price                       = { currency_code = "USD", amount = "49.99" }
          new_subscriber_availability = true
        }
      }
    }

    # A base plan that has been active cannot be deleted. Retire it instead,
    # and keep it declared.
    weekly = {
      state = "INACTIVE"

      auto_renewing = {
        billing_period_duration = "P1W"
      }

      regional_configs = {
        US = {
          price = { currency_code = "USD", amount = "1.99" }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  tax_and_compliance_settings = {
    eea_withdrawal_right_type = "WITHDRAWAL_RIGHT_SERVICE"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `listings` (Attributes Map) The store listing of the subscription by BCP-47 language code, for example `en-US`. It must have an entry for the default language of the app. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--listings))
- `package_name` (String) The package name (application id) of the app, for example `com.example.app`. The app must already exist in Play Console: the API cannot create one. Changing it creates a new subscription.
- `product_id` (String) The product id of the subscription, unique within the app: lower-case letters, digits, underscores and dots, starting with a letter or digit, at most 40 characters. **A product id is reserved forever**, even after the subscription is deleted, so it cannot be reused. Changing it creates a new subscription.

### Optional

- `base_plans` (Attributes Map) The base plans of the subscription by base plan id: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, at most 63 characters. A base plan sets the billing period and the prices that apply when no offer does. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--base_plans))
- `latency_tolerance` (String) How quickly a change must reach clients: `PRODUCT_UPDATE_LATENCY_TOLERANCE_LATENCY_SENSITIVE` (within minutes; at most 7,200 updates per app per hour) or `PRODUCT_UPDATE_LATENCY_TOLERANCE_LATENCY_TOLERANT` (within 24 hours; a far higher quota). It is sent with every call that accepts it. Left out, the API uses latency-sensitive. It is a setting of the request, not of the product: changing it alone calls nothing.
- `regions_version` (String) The version of Google Play's list of available regions that the regional prices in this configuration are written against. The API requires it on every call that creates or changes the product, and accepts an older version than the current one. Defaults to `2022/02`. Google publishes the current version in [this article](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/10532353), and the `googleplay_converted_region_prices` data source reports it as `region_version`. The API does not report which version a subscription was last written with, so the value is only what the configuration says.
- `restricted_payment_countries` (Set of String) Region codes of the countries where the purchase is restricted to payment methods registered in the same country. Left out, there is no restriction.
- `tax_and_compliance_settings` (Attributes) Tax and legal compliance settings. Left out, the settings Google Play assigns are read back and kept. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tax_and_compliance_settings))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `{package_name}/{product_id}`.

<a id="nestedatt--listings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `listings`

Required:

- `title` (String) The title of the subscription in this language. Plain text.

Optional:

- `benefits` (List of String) Up to four benefits shown to the user, in order. Plain text.
- `description` (String) The description of the subscription in this language. Plain text, at most 200 characters.


<a id="nestedatt--base_plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `base_plans`

Optional:

- `auto_renewing` (Attributes) Makes this a base plan that renews automatically at the end of each billing period. Exactly one of `auto_renewing`, `prepaid` and `installments` must be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--base_plans--auto_renewing))
- `installments` (Attributes) Makes this an installments base plan, where the user commits to a number of payments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--base_plans--installments))
- `offer_tags` (Set of String) Up to 20 custom tags for this base plan, returned to the app by the billing library. Each is lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, at most 20 characters.
- `other_regions_config` (Attributes) The prices to use in any region Google Play launches in later. Left out, the base plan is not made available in new regions automatically. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--base_plans--other_regions_config))
- `prepaid` (Attributes) Makes this a base plan that does not renew: the user tops it up by hand. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--base_plans--prepaid))
- `regional_configs` (Attributes Map) The price and availability of the base plan by region code, for example `US`. A region left out is one the base plan is not sold in. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--base_plans--regional_configs))
- `state` (String) The state of the base plan: `DRAFT`, `ACTIVE` or `INACTIVE`. A new base plan is a draft until activated. Set `ACTIVE` to make it available and `INACTIVE` to retire it; the provider reaches the state with the `basePlans.activate` and `basePlans.deactivate` calls. A base plan that has left `DRAFT` cannot return to it. Left out, the state is whatever the API reports and is never changed.

<a id="nestedatt--base_plans--auto_renewing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `base_plans.auto_renewing`

Required:

- `billing_period_duration` (String) The billing period as an ISO 8601 duration, for example `P1M` or `P1Y`. The API does not allow it to change once the base plan exists.

Optional:

- `account_hold_duration` (String) The account hold period as an ISO 8601 duration in days, between `P0D` and `P60D`. Left out, the API uses the recommended hold. The grace period and the account hold must add up to between 30 and 60 days.
- `grace_period_duration` (String) The grace period as an ISO 8601 duration in days, between `P0D` and the lesser of `P30D` and the billing period. Left out, the API picks a default from the billing period.
- `legacy_compatible` (Boolean) Whether this is the base plan the deprecated `querySkuDetailsAsync()` billing method returns. At most one renewing base plan of a subscription can be. Defaults to `false`.
- `legacy_compatible_subscription_offer_id` (String) The id of the subscription offer that is legacy compatible, if any.
- `proration_mode` (String) What happens when a user switches to this plan from another base plan: `SUBSCRIPTION_PRORATION_MODE_CHARGE_ON_NEXT_BILLING_DATE`, `SUBSCRIPTION_PRORATION_MODE_CHARGE_FULL_PRICE_IMMEDIATELY`. The API defaults to charging on the next billing date.
- `resubscribe_state` (String) Whether users can resubscribe to the base plan from Google Play: `RESUBSCRIBE_STATE_ACTIVE`, `RESUBSCRIBE_STATE_INACTIVE`. The API defaults to `RESUBSCRIBE_STATE_ACTIVE`.


<a id="nestedatt--base_plans--installments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `base_plans.installments`

Required:

- `billing_period_duration` (String) The billing period as an ISO 8601 duration, for example `P1M` or `P1Y`. The API does not allow it to change once the base plan exists.
- `committed_payments_count` (Number) The number of payments the user commits to. The API does not allow it to change once the base plan exists.
- `renewal_type` (String) What happens at the end of the initial commitment: `RENEWAL_TYPE_RENEWS_WITHOUT_COMMITMENT`, `RENEWAL_TYPE_RENEWS_WITH_COMMITMENT`. The API does not allow it to change once the base plan exists.

Optional:

- `account_hold_duration` (String) The account hold period as an ISO 8601 duration in days, between `P0D` and `P60D`. Left out, the API uses the recommended hold. The grace period and the account hold must add up to between 30 and 60 days.
- `grace_period_duration` (String) The grace period as an ISO 8601 duration in days, between `P0D` and the lesser of `P30D` and the billing period. Left out, the API picks a default from the billing period.
- `proration_mode` (String) What happens when a user switches to this plan from another base plan: `SUBSCRIPTION_PRORATION_MODE_CHARGE_ON_NEXT_BILLING_DATE`, `SUBSCRIPTION_PRORATION_MODE_CHARGE_FULL_PRICE_IMMEDIATELY`. The API defaults to charging on the next billing date.
- `resubscribe_state` (String) Whether users can resubscribe to the base plan from Google Play: `RESUBSCRIBE_STATE_ACTIVE`, `RESUBSCRIBE_STATE_INACTIVE`. The API defaults to `RESUBSCRIBE_STATE_ACTIVE`.


<a id="nestedatt--base_plans--other_regions_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `base_plans.other_regions_config`

Required:

- `eur_price` (Attributes) The price in EUR for new regions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--base_plans--other_regions_config--eur_price))
- `usd_price` (Attributes) The price in USD for new regions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--base_plans--other_regions_config--usd_price))

Optional:

- `new_subscriber_availability` (Boolean) Whether new subscribers in new regions can buy the base plan. Defaults to `false`.

<a id="nestedatt--base_plans--other_regions_config--eur_price"></a>
### Nested Schema for `base_plans.other_regions_config.eur_price`

Required:

- `amount` (String) The amount as a decimal string, for example `"4.99"`. It is converted to the API's units and nanos exactly, never through a floating-point number, and `"4.50"` and `"4.5"` are the same amount. At most 9 fractional digits.
- `currency_code` (String) The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code, for example `USD`.


<a id="nestedatt--base_plans--other_regions_config--usd_price"></a>
### Nested Schema for `base_plans.other_regions_config.usd_price`

Required:

- `amount` (String) The amount as a decimal string, for example `"4.99"`. It is converted to the API's units and nanos exactly, never through a floating-point number, and `"4.50"` and `"4.5"` are the same amount. At most 9 fractional digits.
- `currency_code` (String) The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code, for example `USD`.



<a id="nestedatt--base_plans--prepaid"></a>
### Nested Schema for `base_plans.prepaid`

Required:

- `billing_period_duration` (String) The billing period as an ISO 8601 duration, for example `P1M` or `P1Y`. The API does not allow it to change once the base plan exists.

Optional:

- `time_extension` (String) Whether users can extend the prepaid plan from Google Play: `TIME_EXTENSION_ACTIVE`, `TIME_EXTENSION_INACTIVE`. The API defaults to `TIME_EXTENSION_ACTIVE`.


<a id="nestedatt--base_plans--regional_configs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `base_plans.regional_configs`

Optional:

- `new_subscriber_availability` (Boolean) Whether new subscribers in the region can buy the base plan. Existing subscribers keep their subscription either way. Defaults to `false`.
- `price` (Attributes) The price in the region, in the currency Google Play links to the region. Required when the base plan is available to new subscribers there. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--base_plans--regional_configs--price))

<a id="nestedatt--base_plans--regional_configs--price"></a>
### Nested Schema for `base_plans.regional_configs.price`

Required:

- `amount` (String) The amount as a decimal string, for example `"4.99"`. It is converted to the API's units and nanos exactly, never through a floating-point number, and `"4.50"` and `"4.5"` are the same amount. At most 9 fractional digits.
- `currency_code` (String) The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code, for example `USD`.




<a id="nestedatt--tax_and_compliance_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tax_and_compliance_settings`

Optional:

- `eea_withdrawal_right_type` (String) The classification of the product for users in the European Economic Area, which decides the withdrawal regime: `WITHDRAWAL_RIGHT_DIGITAL_CONTENT`, `WITHDRAWAL_RIGHT_SERVICE`.
- `is_tokenized_digital_asset` (Boolean) Whether the subscription is declared as a product representing a tokenized digital asset. Defaults to `false`.
- `product_age_rating_tier_by_region_code` (Map of String) The age rating tier of the product by region code. The API currently supports only the region `US`. Each value is one of: `PRODUCT_AGE_RATING_TIER_EVERYONE`, `PRODUCT_AGE_RATING_TIER_THIRTEEN_AND_ABOVE`, `PRODUCT_AGE_RATING_TIER_SIXTEEN_AND_ABOVE`, `PRODUCT_AGE_RATING_TIER_EIGHTEEN_AND_ABOVE`.
- `product_tax_category_code` (String) The product tax category code, which decides the transaction tax rates applied.
- `tax_rate_info_by_region_code` (Attributes Map) Tax rate details by region code. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tax_and_compliance_settings--tax_rate_info_by_region_code))

<a id="nestedatt--tax_and_compliance_settings--tax_rate_info_by_region_code"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tax_and_compliance_settings.tax_rate_info_by_region_code`

Optional:

- `eligible_for_streaming_service_tax_rate` (Boolean) Whether the product is a streaming product, for US state and local sales tax. Only supported in the United States. Defaults to `false`.
- `streaming_tax_type` (String) The tax category for communications or amusement taxes in the United States: `STREAMING_TAX_TYPE_TELCO_VIDEO_RENTAL`, `STREAMING_TAX_TYPE_TELCO_VIDEO_SALES`, `STREAMING_TAX_TYPE_TELCO_VIDEO_MULTI_CHANNEL`, `STREAMING_TAX_TYPE_TELCO_AUDIO_RENTAL`, `STREAMING_TAX_TYPE_TELCO_AUDIO_SALES`, `STREAMING_TAX_TYPE_TELCO_AUDIO_MULTI_CHANNEL`.
- `tax_tier` (String) The tax tier for a reduced tax rate: `TAX_TIER_BOOKS_1`, `TAX_TIER_NEWS_1`, `TAX_TIER_NEWS_2`, `TAX_TIER_MUSIC_OR_AUDIO_1`, `TAX_TIER_LIVE_OR_BROADCAST_1`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = googleplay_subscription.premium
  id = "com.example.app/premium"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a subscription, with its base plans, by package name and product id.
tofu import googleplay_subscription.premium com.example.app/premium
```
